summary_1line: Hanuman proves his identity with Rama’s ring, and Sita questions him anxiously about Rama while Hanuman reassures her of Rama’s grief and coming rescue.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sita in the Ashoka grove receives Rama’s ring from Hanuman and gazes at it with tearful joy as if seeing Rama himself.
Hanuman stands respectfully with folded palms before Sita beneath the trees of the grove while she questions him anxiously about Rama.
Far away in the forest, Rama sits thin and sorrowful, murmuring Sita’s name while insects crawl on him unnoticed.
